pages.text: Look for Garrick Ashford, Professor Alden Voss, Mara Coppersmith, Captain Edda Thorne and Sister Ysra Vale in their distinct generated homes and work sites. These are separate characters with their own requests, rather than interchangeable quest stations.

Mark a useful location and return as your supplies improve. Garrick’s forge and the other survivors’ homes change through their restoration work. Keep the people and their requests in mind as you build your workshop.
